report.Title: Registration Error: Password Requirements Not Met
report.Summary: User receives an error message when attempting to create an account due to insufficient password length.
Steps: Navigate to the 'Create account' page.
Input the email 'dev@example.com'.
Input a password shorter than 12 characters.
Click on 'Create account'.
Observe the error message stating 'Password must contain at least 12 characters' after submission.

matched_facts: Password must contain at least 12 characters

report.Title: Duplicate Payment Submission Error
report.Summary: The system incorrectly allows duplicate payment submissions, resulting in multiple invoices being created for the same transaction.
Steps: 1. Navigate to the 'Review order' page displaying a summary of a Team plan for $49.00.
2. Click the 'Place order' button to initiate the payment process.
3. Observe the error message displayed: 'Payment submitted twice'.
4. Note the presence of two invoices: 'Invoice #4812' and 'Invoice #4813', both displaying '$49.00 · Processing'.

report.Title: Button Overflow in Mobile View
report.Summary: The action buttons in the mobile profile view overflow the mobile viewport, causing potential usability issues.
Steps: View mobile profile screen where buttons are displayed
Observe the 'Message' and 'Delete' buttons overlap or extend beyond the visible area

missing_facts: Action buttons overflow the mobile viewport

report.Title: Loading Account Stuck
report.Summary: The account overview fails to load, displaying a loader indefinitely and showing an error after 2 minutes.
Steps: Navigate to the Account Overview page.
Observe the message 'Loading account...' and the loading spinner.
Wait for 2 minutes without the account details appearing.
Note the error message 'Still loading after 2 minutes' and 'Workspace details never appeared' displayed in red.

report.Title: 404 Error Navigating to Billing Settings
report.Summary: User encounters a 404 error when attempting to access the billing settings page after clicking on 'Manage billing'. The error message states that the path '/settings/billing' could not be found.
Steps: On the Billing settings page, the user clicks the 'Manage billing' button.
The user is redirected to a page displaying a '404' error with the message: 'The path /settings/billing could not be found.'

report.Title: Checkout Error: Card Number Validation Failure
report.Summary: The checkout process fails to accept a valid card number format due to an insufficient digit count, resulting in an error message after attempting to proceed.
Steps: Observe the initial checkout screen displaying 'Card number: 4242 4242 4242 4242' and 'Expiry: 12/29'.
Attempt to proceed with the payment by clicking 'Pay $49.00'.
Upon the next screen, observe the error message: 'Card number must contain 16 digits', indicating the card number entered is invalid.

report.Title: Insufficient Contrast Warning in Developer Settings
report.Summary: The UI displays a warning regarding insufficient contrast for the warning text against the dark card background.
Steps: Navigate to Developer settings.
Observe the API credentials section.
Note the presence of the warning: 'The key warning text has insufficient contrast against the dark card.'

report.Title: Stale Status Badge Not Updating
report.Summary: After resolving all incidents, the header badge still incorrectly shows '12 open'.
Steps: Navigate to the Incidents page.
Observe the message '12 incidents require attention' indicating unresolved incidents.
Resolve all incidents.
Observe message '0 active incidents' indicating no unresolved incidents.
Note that the header badge still shows '12 open' despite there being zero active incidents.

report.Title: Upload Recording Stuck at 73%
report.Summary: The upload process for the video file 'checkout-bug.webm' halts at 73% with a message indicating no progress for 5 minutes.
Steps: Begin uploading 'checkout-bug.webm'.
Initial upload progress reaches 32% (18.4 MB of 57.5 MB).
Upload progress increases to 73%.
Observe the text: 'No progress for 5 minutes'.

report.Title: Table Clipping Issue in Workspace Members View
report.Summary: The email of a workspace member is clipped and not fully readable, resulting in a user-facing error message indicating the issue.
Steps: Navigate to the Workspace members section.
Observe the email entry for a member named 'alexandra.longlastn...' which is incomplete.
Note the displayed error message: 'Member email is clipped and cannot be read' in red below the email.

scoring_note: Automated exact-fact scoring is a regression signal; release still requires human hallucination review.
